harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Locked the curl package version on node1 using dnf versionlock (curl-0:8.12.1-4.el10.*), verified it is excluded from update transactions while unrelated packages (e.g. libcurl) still update normally, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline, issued a native systemctl reboot, confirmed the node went unreachable and came back, proved the boot_id changed (83a0a80f... -> 0f15c938...), and reverified post-reboot that curl is still locked at its original version, the system is healthy (systemctl is-system-running: running), and a dry-run update still excludes curl.
actions_performed: Captured baseline curl version, boot_id, and system health on node1
Added a dnf versionlock rule for curl-0:8.12.1-4.el10.*
Verified via dnf update dry-run/test transactions that curl is excluded from updates
Issued sudo -n systemctl reboot on node1 (single node, native safe reboot)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Reverified post-reboot that the curl versionlock persisted, curl version is unchanged, and system health/update exclusion still hold

evidence.requirement: curl package version held/locked so system updates leave it unchanged
evidence.summary: Baseline showed curl-8.12.1-4.el10 with no versionlock plugin installed; after installing python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock and running dnf versionlock add curl, the lock list shows curl-0:8.12.1-4.el10.*, and dnf update dry-run/test transactions show 'Nothing to do' / omit curl (only unrelated libcurl appears in the full dry-run), confirming curl is excluded from upgrades while curl's own rpm version remains 8.12.1-4.el10.
Captured boot_id 83a0a80f-773c-4f3e-9137-1e7aa887b07a, confirmed curl versionlock still in place, curl version unchanged, and systemctl is-system-running reported 'running'.
Issued backgrounded sudo -n systemctl reboot; the exec stream closed before completion (reboot took effect), and subsequent polls showed connection timeout/reset while the node was down.

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Exec connectivity returned with boot_id 0f15c938-dc51-4e28-8c08-7cffd2114a3c, differing from the pre-reboot boot_id 83a0a80f-773c-4f3e-9137-1e7aa887b07a, proving an actual restart occurred.

evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of required state (curl version lock, system health)
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: boot_id confirmed as the new value, dnf versionlock list still shows curl-0:8.12.1-4.el10.*, rpm -q curl still reports 8.12.1-4.el10 (unchanged), systemctl is-system-running reports 'running', and a dnf update dry-run again excludes curl from the update set.
